concept: Emotional support and room to breathe
brief: A warm mental-wellbeing and emotional-support emblem: two soft eucalyptus-teal cupped hand/arm forms make a clean OPEN HEART silhouette around a small pale-sage human figure, represented by a round head and gentle shoulder curve. Generous air between the protective arms and the person gives breathing room. The silhouette must clearly read as a person held in a caring heart, not a decorative face, lungs, leaf or infinity loop. Teal #4A7480, sage #AEC7BB, off-white #F0F4F1. Tactile understated ceramic, very few rounded forms; no medical cross, ECG or clinical imagery.
prompt: Design one original premium mobile-app BRAND SYMBOL, transparent RGBA square canvas, no wordmark or generated text.
